verdict.rationale: ADK does not ship its own natural-language command interface. It does publish first-party ADK developer Skills and an Agents CLI built so that a user's AI coding assistant can scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy agents from natural-language requests. The NL interpreter itself is the user's external assistant, so ADK's role is first-party enablement for that assistant. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for operating ADK, documentation of which operations the Skills cover and how, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
